html: Here is a video I made a while ago, which illustrates a few basic techniques of astronomical image processing with photoshop. The Messier 51 image was calibrated (Flat and Bias)  and integrated (average with sigma rejection) beforehand in PixInsight. The final result is available in a previous entry.
